interventions.title: Enhanced Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility paint or different paving materials across the driveway entrance to alert drivers to the pedestrian zone.

interventions.title: Street Trees or Planters
interventions.description: Install large planters or street trees to create a physical buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Garage Exit Warning Systems
interventions.description: Install visual and audible alerts at the garage exit to warn pedestrians of emerging vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Planter Buffer
interventions.description: Utilize the wide sidewalk to install more continuous planters or street furniture to create a physical buffer from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to facilitate safe crossing to the theater.

interventions.title: Mid-Block Crossing with Refuge
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Protected Bike Lane
interventions.description: Convert a portion of the roadway or parking lane into a protected bike lane to provide a buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Designated Pick-up/Drop-off Zone
interventions.description: Clearly delineate a specific area for taxi and rideshare loading to minimize unpredictable stops and maintain clear pedestrian flow.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Audible/Visual Exit Warnings
interventions.description: Install flashing lights or an audible alarm that triggers when a vehicle approaches the exit to warn pedestrians.

interventions.title: Conflict Zone Markings
interventions.description: Use high-visibility pavement markings or different materials across the garage exit to alert pedestrians and drivers to the conflict area.

interventions.title: Convex Mirrors
interventions.description: Install mirrors at the garage exit to allow drivers to see pedestrians approaching from the sides before they cross the sidewalk.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of travel lanes to naturally slow traffic speeds and reclaim space for pedestrian or bicycle infrastructure.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Establish specific loading zones away from high-pedestrian activity areas or intersections to manage delivery vehicle placement.
